disambiguation_schema.lexical_polysemy: Queries where a surface token in restaurant brand names conflicts with the requested culinary/operational concept (e.g., Green salad vs Greenwich/Green Coffee; 24 hours vs 24 Chicken; Tokyo sushi vs Tokyo Waffle; Durian pastry vs Durian Dub Burgers).
disambiguation_schema.category_confusion: Queries requiring fine-grained food taxonomy separation or distinguishing regional food-style modifiers in Davao City (e.g., Cebu puso BBQ in Davao City) from out-of-scope cities.
disambiguation_schema.spelling_synonym: Queries using Davao Bisaya/Cebuano culinary vocabulary (kan-anan, sinugba, kinilaw, sutukil, painitan) or common phonetic/transliteration variants (sangyup, ramyun, shwarma, briyani).
disambiguation_schema.mixed_intent: Queries combining two distinct culinary categories within a shared spatial or social group context.
disambiguation_schema.anaphoric_followup: Multi-turn queries relying on pronominal or comparative coreference (those, them, which ones, the cheaper ones) and conversational state.
disambiguation_schema.underspecified_ambiguous: Open-ended or mood/context-driven dining queries without explicit food-type keywords.

annotation_provenance: Multi-criteria dataset-and-review verified benchmark (v3.0). Includes 62 in-scope single-turn, disambiguation, numeric price-ceiling, & multi-turn cases plus 10 out-of-scope boundary cases (72 total) across train/dev/test splits. Use evaluation/annotate.php to collect independent blind human annotations before claiming human-validated agreement.
labeling_rule: Ordered relevance grades: 3 = exact Davao City match satisfying all primary, numeric price-ceiling, disambiguation, and secondary query constraints with verified evidence; 2 = relevant Davao City match satisfying primary intent; 1 = partial/related Davao City match; 0 = non-relevant, polysemy trap, price-ceiling violation, or outside Davao City.
